review.summary: The CLI and subprocess tests correctly implement the stated scope: two sequential trusted local mock handler invocations through the real execute_capability_request with fixed local.generate grants, pending→ready success at exit 0, pending→failure with no output key at exit 1 for invalid metadata, pre-cancel/missing-grant refusals before any handler call (0 attempts, empty provider_calls, exit 1), one JSON document on stdout (stderr empty on success, argparse exit 2 with empty stdout for unknown flags), and cwd-independent operation via __file__/ROOT resolution. Acceptance fits the metadata-only contract with no audio bytes, licence, playback, or content approval, but uncertainty remains: fixture_only/no_audio_bytes/content_hash '0'*64/verification statuses are self-declared or hard-coded fixture literals rather than independent evidence, provider_calls are local handler self-reports not telemetry authority, exception/serialization failures would emit non-JSON stdout (exercised by no test), and no test-run output was supplied to confirm pass status against the actual language_matrix.capabilities module; P03 is not automatically approved.

authorship: Qwen initial draft; after repeated empty repair turns controller replaced implementation/tests/docs. No attribution of controller repairs to Qwen.
limits: Metadata-only local mock; provider_calls reflect local handler activity only. No audio bytes/licensing/playback/teaching approval, no automatic whole-P03 acceptance.
